sourceCitation: Fred Calef; USGS Astrogeology Science Center; Planetary Data System. Cite the USGS product page and the source papers listed in the XML metadata.
processing: Mean of each 5 by 5 CTX DEM block; output stored as signed 16-bit metres. Any output cell containing a source NoData sample is retained as NoData.
coordinateSystem: Mars 2000 sphere, Equidistant Cylindrical (equirectangular); east-positive longitude and planetocentric latitude.
knownLimitations: 100 m route grid derived from a 20 m CTX DEM; it smooths terrain at the planning scale and does not resolve small rocks or suit-scale hazards.
The full raster footprint includes terrain surrounding Jezero crater; the rectangular raster edge is not the crater rim.
CTX stereo elevations and derived slopes are model products; route results are educational candidates and are not certified safe.

overviewImage.coverageHandling: Pixels outside the source ortho footprint are transparent; the source is geospatially resampled, not stretched to the DEM bounds.
